reason: A browser UI enhancement that adds a persistent animated pixel whale to the DSH Web UI session header and reacts to session state and clicks without modifying model requests or tool schemas.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏中添加一只根据会话状态展示眨眼、摆尾、思考、庆祝和睡眠动画的像素鲸鱼伙伴。
summaries.en: Adds a pixel whale companion to the DSH Web UI session header with animations that respond to session activity, completion, idle time, and clicks.

capabilities: Renders a persistent animated pixel whale in the DSH Web UI session header
Reads session snapshot state to drive animations such as thinking, completion, idle, and sleeping
Handles click interaction to display a heart animation
